info.title: Aurify plugin local protocol
info.description: What a plugin process serves to the Aurify client on 127.0.0.1. The client talks to the process directly, never through a server. Every request carries X-Aurify-Plugin-Secret, generated by the client per install and handed to the process through AURIFY_PLUGIN_SECRET. The server binds loopback only, but any process on the machine can reach loopback; the secret is what tells the client apart from a stray page doing fetch("http://127.0.0.1").

status.description: starting is the initial state, so a probe during warm-up says wait, not broken.

args.description: Arguments as declared by the operation's args schema in the manifest.

result.description: Any JSON. For a screen's modelOperation, the screen's model.

code.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE machine code for the client to branch on.

401.description: Secret missing or wrong; the two are not told apart

get.summary: What this process claims to be
get.description: The client compares it with the manifest of the installed package: a process answering for a different manifest is not the plugin that was installed.

post.description: One dispatch path for data and actions alike: a screen's model is loaded by posting to its modelOperation. Bodies above 1 MiB are refused before they are read; a file goes through the platform's storage and arrives as an id.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: An operation name declared in the manifest. Undeclared names are 404 even if the process could answer.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object with an args field

404.description: The manifest does not declare this operation

422.description: The operation refused: the handler's own code and message
